---
title: Filename special characters
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("a\$b\.py"'
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("c#d\.py"'
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("e\*f_g\.py"'
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("123"'
          - 'replace\(regex\("\[/_\.-\]"\), m => m\.text \+ "\\u\{200b\}"\)'
          - 'replace\(regex\("\[\.\]\\u\{200b\}\(\[\^\.\]\*\)\\\\z"\)'
          - 'replace\(regex\("\[\^/_\.\\u\{200b\}-\]\{31,\}"\)'
        - []
---

```{.python filename="a$b.py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="c#d.py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="e*f_g.py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="`tick`.py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="say \"hi\".py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename="LONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAMELONGNAME.py"}
x = 1
```

```{.python filename=123}
x = 1
```
